subject: Guidance on Node.js vs Python Backend
message: Respected Sir, I am currently learning React. Should I learn Node.js next or Python Django for backend development?
reply: Dear Aarav, since you are already learning React, Node.js is an excellent natural choice for full-stack JavaScript (MERN). Focus on Node.js first!
